info.description:
Recipes, grocery items and the grocery list for the MamieNellie app.
Sign in (locally: POST /auth/dev), then click Authorize and enter "Bearer <accessToken>".
info.title: MamieNellie API

post.description: Creates the account on the first sign-in. Send the name Apple shows on that first sign-in; Apple never repeats it.
Only exists when running locally, for trying the API from Swagger. The same name signs into the same test account.
post.summary: Sign in without Apple or Google (local only)

post.description: Creates the account on the first sign-in.
Trades a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. Each refresh token works once; keep the new one.
Ends the session the refresh token belongs to. Succeeds for an already-ended session too.

get.description:
Everything the app needs to describe groceries and convert amounts offline: the
units, and the account's categories and items (hidden ones too) with their units
and conversions. Send the last ETag as If-None-Match: when nothing changed, the
answer is 304 with no body.
get.summary: Get the units, categories and grocery items

parameters.description: ETag of the catalog the app already has
parameters.name: If-None-Match

put.description: Starter categories can be renamed too.

delete.description:
Only the account's own categories, and only once no item is in them. Starter ones
can be hidden instead.

409.description: A starter category, or one with items in it

put.description: A hidden category isn't offered when picking one; its items stay in it.

get.description: One line per item, in the order lines were first added.

post.description:
Applies the actions in order, each on its own, and returns what happened to each
and the list after them. Lines are named by item:
- add {itemId, unitId, quantity}: onto the item's line, converted into its unit
- setQuantity {itemId, quantity}: the amount, by hand, in the line's unit
- setUnit {itemId, unitId}: another unit the item is bought in, converting the amount
- check / uncheck / remove {itemId}, and clearChecked

Every action has an ID the app makes once. Resending an action already applied
changes nothing (outcome alreadyApplied), so after a dropped connection the app
just sends its queue again. A rejected action changed nothing and can be sent again
once fixed: missingConversion says which conversion to ask the user for. Up to 200
actions per request.

Sent once, after the first sign-in, with the app's stored data as it is (data
version 4). Starter categories and items are matched to the account's copies by
their seed IDs ("item-garlic") and take on the local changes; the user's own are
matched by name or created. Units the service doesn't have become "piece".
Recipes are created, meals not yet cooked are planned, and grocery lines join the
list. Anything that can't be kept as it is is changed or left out, and listed in
notes. It all happens or none of it does. Resending the same importId returns the
first import's result with imported false. Afterwards, upload each recipe's photo
to its new ID from recipeIds, then delete the local data.
post.summary: Import the data the app kept on the phone

parameters.description: The import's ID and the app's stored data
parameters.name: payload

post.description:
Conversions are the item's own ("1 head = 10 clove"); standard ones (1 kg = 1000 g)
follow from the units and are refused. Each must be needed: one that already follows
from the others is refused, so two rules can't disagree.

put.description:
Starter items can be changed too. Leave out conversions to keep the saved ones,
minus any naming a unit the item no longer has.

delete.description: Only the account's own items. Starter ones can be hidden instead.

post.description:
"1 fromUnit = factor toUnit" for this item, replacing the one for the same two units
(either way round) if there is one. Used to answer "1 box = ? piece".
post.summary: Add a conversion to a grocery item

put.description: A hidden item isn't offered when picking one.
put.summary: Hide or show a grocery item

delete.description: Deletes the account and everything saved with it, and ends all its sessions. It can't be undone.

get.description: The planned meals, in the order they were planned.

put.description:
The app makes the meal's ID (a UUID), so it can plan meals offline and send them
later. Sending the same meal again just saves it again.
put.summary: Plan a meal, or change one

parameters.description: Meal ID, made by the app
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: The recipe and number of people
parameters.name: payload

400.description: Not a UUID, or not one of the account's recipes

409.description: Another account's meal has this ID

delete.description: The grocery list is left as it is. Removing a meal that's already gone succeeds.
delete.summary: Take a meal off the menu

get.description: By name, each with its ingredients and steps.

post.description:
Each ingredient is one of the account's grocery items, in a unit it's cooked in (or,
for an item nobody cooks with, one it's bought in).

get.description: Pass servings to get the ingredient amounts for that many people.

parameters.description: Scale the ingredients to this many people (1 to 99)
parameters.name: servings

put.description: Replaces its name, servings, ingredients and steps. The photo stays.

delete.description: Its planned meals and photo go with it. What it added to the grocery list stays.

put.summary: Set a recipe's photo to one just uploaded

parameters.description: The photoKey from the upload link
parameters.name: payload

400.description: Not uploaded, too large, or not an image

503.description: Photos aren't set up where the service runs

post.description:
Upload the image itself with the returned method, URL and headers, within 15
minutes, then attach it with PUT /recipes/{id}/photo. Photos up to 10 MB.
post.summary: Get a link to upload a recipe photo to

503.description: Photos aren't set up where the service runs

idToken.description: IDToken is the identityToken from Sign in with Apple.

name.description: Name is the full name Apple shows the app on the first sign-in only. Optional.
Name picks the local test account; the same name signs into the same account.

conversions.description:
Conversions replace the item's. Leave it out to keep the saved ones (minus any naming a unit
the item no longer has).

idToken.description: IDToken is the idToken from Google Sign-In.

id.description: ID is made by the app, once per action: resending the same action is then harmless.

itemId.description: ItemID names the line, for every type but clearChecked.

quantity.description: Quantity is the amount for add and setQuantity.

unitId.description: UnitID is the amount's unit for add, and the new unit for setUnit.

error.description: Error says why a rejected action was refused.

missingConversion.description: MissingConversion is set when the action needs a conversion the item doesn't have yet.

lines.description: Lines is the list after the actions; it replaces the app's preview.

quantity.description:
Quantity is exact (0.04 after 2 tbsp of oil); BuyQuantity is what to show, rounded up to
whole numbers for units sold whole (1 bottle).

hidden.description: Hidden leaves the record out of the app's pickers; false shows it again.

imported.description: Imported is false when this import was done before; the result is the first one's.

notes.description: Notes say what the import had to change or leave out, to show the user.

recipeIds.description: RecipeIDs maps each local recipe ID to its new ID: upload each recipe's photo to it.

importId.description:
ImportID is made by the app once and kept until the import is done, so a resend is
recognised.

version.description: Version is the app's data version; the app migrates its data to 4 before sending it.

fromUnitId.description: Ask the user "1 fromUnit = ? toUnit", then save it with POST /items/{id}/conversions.

photoKey.description: PhotoKey is what to attach to the recipe once the upload is done.

uploadUrl.description: Upload the image with this method, URL and headers (the body is the image itself).

photoUrl.description: PhotoURL is where the photo is served from, or null.

servings.description: Servings is how many people the ingredient amounts are for.

example: Warm the olive oil in a wide pan.

newAccount.description: NewAccount is true when this sign-in created the account, e.g. to show onboarding.

baseUnitId.description:
BaseUnitID and BaseSize: one of this unit is BaseSize of BaseUnitID (1 cup = 240 ml). Units
with the same base convert into each other. Both null for units whose size depends on the
item (pack, head…).

soldWhole.description: SoldWhole: the grocery list rounds amounts in this unit up to whole numbers.

BearerAuth.description: "Bearer " followed by the accessToken from signing in.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
